draft.text: You came in because you have back pain on your right side.
The pain started after you fell down stairs at a surprise birthday party.
Your pain is worse when you lie flat or twist.
You have stiffness in your back, especially when twisting.
You do not have numbness, tingling, weakness, swelling, or bruising.
You had a lumbar fusion surgery in the past, but you don't remember the exact level or any problems from it.
Your back pain and stiffness may be related to your past surgery.
The X-ray today showed the spinal fusion.
The next steps will be discussed.
